svg.metadata:
# looply 商品上架全流程系统流程图（基于自建系统） V2.0 # 研发编码参考数据，从 SVG <metadata> 提取
swimlanes: - key: "E" name: "外部数据源" - key: "A" name: "商品系统（商家视角）" - key: "B" name: "商品系统（平台视角）" - key: "C" name: "库存系统"
sections: - name: "① 选品定价" steps: - type: start_end text: "开始：选品定价" - type: cross_lane from: "A" to: "E" text: "获取仓内原始商品Excel(中文)" - type: process lane: "E" text: "仓内原始商品Excel(人工导出)" - type: cross_lane from: "E" to: "A" text: "上传Excel" - type: process lane: "A" text: "解析Excel(品类/品牌/系列/尺码/成色/折扣价)" - type: cross_lane from: "A" to: "E" text: "获取TRR参考价数据" - type: process lane: "E" text: "TRR参考价(4.4 top_series+avg_prices)" - type: cross_lane from: "E" to: "A" text: "返回参考价" - type: process lane: "A" text: "品牌/系列/尺码/成色匹配→参考均价C" - type: decision lane: "A" text: "匹配到参考均价?" on_no: "标记无均价" yes_label: "是" no_label: "否" - type: process lane: "A" text: "计算定价公式(B1=1.47A+110, B2=1.30A+98)" - type: decision lane: "A" text: "满足选品公式?" on_no: "标记不选中" yes_label: "是" no_label: "否" - type: decision lane: "A" text: "通过剔除规则?" on_no: "剔除" yes_label: "是" no_label: "否" - type: process lane: "A" text: "生成选中商品清单(含目标售价B)" - type: start_end text: "选品定价完成" - name: "② 商品翻译" steps: - type: start_end text: "开始：商品翻译" - type: process lane: "A" text: "加载选中商品数据" - type: cross_lane from: "A" to: "E" text: "获取标准翻译表" - type: process lane: "E" text: "标准翻译表(4.3 共15类术语)" - type: cross_lane from: "E" to: "A" text: "返回术语数据" - type: process lane: "A" text: "逐字段翻译(品牌/系列/颜色/材质/尺码/瑕疵)" - type: process lane: "A" text: "按类目规则组装Product Name" - type: decision lane: "A" text: "中文残留审计通过?" on_no: "标记warning" yes_label: "是" no_label: "否" - type: process lane: "A" text: "生成英文商品数据(标准化字段)" - type: start_end text: "商品翻译完成" - name: "③ 商品上架" steps: - type: start_end text: "开始：商品上架" - type: process lane: "A" text: "加载英文商品数据(②输出)" - type: cross_lane from: "A" to: "B" text: "查询external_item_id是否已存在" - type: decision lane: "B" text: "external_item_id已存在?" on_no: "跳过该条" yes_label: "是" no_label: "否" - type: cross_lane from: "B" to: "A" text: "返回冲突检测结果" - type: process lane: "A" text: "生成预览清单(ready/skip)" - type: decision lane: "A" text: "运营确认上架?" on_no: "取消" yes_label: "是" no_label: "否" - type: cross_lane from: "A" to: "B" text: "请求创建标品SKU" - type: decision lane: "B" text: "SKU已存在?" on_no: "复用已有SKU" yes_label: "否" no_label: "是" - type: process lane: "B" text: "创建标品SKU(brand+series+category+属性)" - type: cross_lane from: "A" to: "B" text: "请求创建实物商品" - type: process lane: "B" text: "创建实物商品(product表)" - type: cross_lane from: "A" to: "C" text: "请求创建库存主体" - type: process lane: "C" text: "创建inventory_item(qty=1)" - type: process lane: "C" text: "写入库存流水(INBOUND +1)" - type: cross_lane from: "A" to: "B" text: "请求创建渠道商品" - type: process lane: "B" text: "创建listing(渠道+市场+挂牌价)" - type: cross_lane from: "A" to: "C" text: "请求创建渠道库存分配" - type: process lane: "C" text: "创建channel_inventory_allocation" - type: process lane: "A" text: "审计验证(多模块回查)" - type: decision lane: "A" text: "验证通过?" on_no: "标记失败" yes_label: "是" no_label: "否" - type: start_end text: "商品上架完成" - name: "④ 商品清理" steps: - type: start_end text: "开始：商品清理" - type: cross_lane from: "A" to: "E" text: "获取实际库存ID文件" - type: process lane: "E" text: "实际库存商品ID文件(人工导出)" - type: cross_lane from: "E" to: "A" text: "上传库存ID" - type: process lane: "A" text: "解析实际库存Item ID列表" - type: cross_lane from: "A" to: "C" text: "查询在库商品(status=ACTIVE)" - type: process lane: "C" text: "返回系统在库Item ID列表" - type: cross_lane from: "C" to: "A" text: "返回比对数据" - type: process lane: "A" text: "比对：系统有但实际无→待清理" - type: process lane: "A" text: "生成待清理清单(展示给运营)" - type: decision lane: "A" text: "运营勾选确认?" on_no: "取消清理" yes_label: "是" no_label: "否" - type: cross_lane from: "A" to: "C" text: "执行库存清零" - type: process lane: "C" text: "更新inventory_item(qty=0,status=SOLD_OUT)" - type: process lane: "C" text: "写入库存流水(ADJUST -1)" - type: cross_lane from: "A" to: "C" text: "释放渠道库存分配" - type: process lane: "C" text: "更新allocation(status=RELEASED)" - type: cross_lane from: "A" to: "B" text: "下架渠道商品" - type: process lane: "B" text: "更新listing(status=已下架)" - type: cross_lane from: "A" to: "B" text: "更新实物商品状态" - type: process lane: "B" text: "更新product(status=已售出)" - type: process lane: "A" text: "回查验证(多模块状态检查)" - type: decision lane: "A" text: "验证通过?" on_no: "标记异常" yes_label: "是" no_label: "否" - type: process lane: "A" text: "生成验证报告(成功/失败/原因)" - type: start_end text: "商品清理完成"
svg.text: looply 商品上架全流程系统流程图（基于自建系统）
获取仓内原始商品Excel(中文)
仓内原始商品Excel(人工导出)
解析Excel(品类/品牌/系列/尺码/成色/折扣价)
品牌/系列/尺码/成色匹配→参考均价C
生成选中商品清单(含目标售价B)
标准翻译表(4.3 共15类术语)
逐字段翻译(品牌/系列/颜色/材质/尺码/瑕疵)
生成英文商品数据(标准化字段)
加载英文商品数据(②输出)
请求创建渠道库存分配
实际库存商品ID文件(人工导出)
解析实际库存Item ID列表
返回系统在库Item ID列表
比对：系统有但实际无→待清理
生成待清理清单(展示给运营)
回查验证(多模块状态检查)
生成验证报告(成功/失败/原因)
